case_title: State of M.P. v. Madan Lal
statutory_provisions: IPC s.376(2)(f) rw s. 511 and s. 354
trial_court_outcome: Convicted under s. 376(2)(f) rw s. 511 and sentenced to rigorous imprisonment for five years
high_court_outcome: Converted the offence to one under s. 354 and confined the sentence to the period of custody already undergone
neutral_facts: The accused raped a seven-year-old girl. The victim was proceeding towards Haar from her home when the accused met her and took her near the river Parvati. He removed her undergarment, made her sit on his lap, and discharged on her private parts and stomach. The victim shouted, and her mother arrived at the scene. The accused fled. The victim narrated the incident to her mother, leading to the lodging of an FIR. The investigating agency examined witnesses, seized the accused's clothes, and sent items for forensic examination. The trial court convicted the accused under s. 376(2)(f) rw s. 511 and sentenced him to rigorous imprisonment for five years. The High Court converted the offence to one under s. 354 and reduced the sentence to the period already undergone.
